name: CopyCopy Synthetic Model Evaluation Dataset
description: Synthetic clipboard fixtures for comparing local LLMs against CopyCopy's goals: fast private transforms, strict instruction following, clean clipboard-ready output, and contextual follow-up usefulness.
globalRejectIf: Emits hidden reasoning or thinking tags such as <think>, </think>, reasoning:, or chain-of-thought prose
Adds assistant chatter such as Sure, Here is, Certainly, or I can help
Mentions that it is an AI model unless explicitly requested
Hallucinates facts not present in the clipboard content
Breaks requested machine-readable output formats such as JSON arrays

scoreScale.2: Partially useful but needs manual cleanup
scoreScale.3: Acceptable clipboard output with minor issues
scoreScale.4: Good output, follows instructions, low cleanup
scoreScale.5: Excellent output, concise, precise, ready to paste

cases.title: Summarize synthetic product article
cases.clipboard:
# Atlas Notes launches offline sync

Atlas Notes today announced offline sync for its macOS app. The feature stores encrypted note changes locally and uploads them when the network returns. According to the company, conflict resolution prefers the newest edit but keeps older versions in note history for manual restore.

The release also adds a compact menu bar indicator that shows pending uploads. Enterprise administrators can disable sync for regulated workspaces. Offline sync is available now for paid plans and will reach free accounts next quarter.

The company said it will publish a technical whitepaper about the encryption design next month.

skills.name: Summarize
skills.goal: Summarize as 3-5 factual bullets.
expectedProperties: Mentions encrypted local changes and upload when network returns
Mentions paid plans now/free next quarter
Does not invent security guarantees beyond the text
rejectIf: Claims sync is available to all users now

cases.title: Rank follow-ups after markdown conversion
cases.clipboard:
# Incident report

The export service returned 504 errors for 18 minutes. The queue backlog peaked at 4,200 jobs. A retry storm from older clients increased database load. The team disabled automatic retries, scaled workers from 4 to 12, and drained the queue by 14:40 UTC.

Next steps: add jitter to retries, cap concurrent exports per workspace, and improve dashboard alerts.

Suggests irrelevant URL or file actions
